rationale: RE-EVALUATED IN THE CORROBORATION CORRECTION PASS (module_sha f69b2cd). This record is rewritten against the corrected M5 5.2a and M5 10 wording, which states that the corroboration flag describes the provenance of the H/L/C actually used to compute a tier, and that a tier computed from the execution price series - the broker series the resulting order is filled and settled against - is CORROBORATED by construction, because that series is the settlement source and not a secondary quote about the market. The gate is reserved for tiers struck from narrative or aggregator quotes whose true prior-period H/L cannot be established. REFERENCE CLOSE: 7489.10, the settled cash close (16:30-23:00 broker = 09:30-16:00 ET) of session 2026-07-01, the last completed US500 session strictly before D=2026-07-02; unchanged from the prior evaluation of this date. PIVOT TIER, RECOMPUTED: the daily floor-trader tier is recomputed directly from the broker price series in data/slices/US500/US500_upto_2026-07-01.csv (US500 broker M15 series, last bar 2026-07-01 23:45:00), taking the H/L/C of the 2026-07-01 cash session 16:30-23:00 broker: H 7525.40 / L 7452.60 / C 7489.10. P = (H+L+C)/3 = 7489.03; R1 = 2P-L = 7525.47; S1 = 2P-H = 7452.67; R2 = P+(H-L) = 7561.83; S2 = P-(H-L) = 7416.23; R3 = H+2(P-L) = 7598.27; S3 = L-2(H-P) = 7379.87; M5 4a midpoints R1.5 = 7543.65 and S1.5 = 7434.45. CORROBORATION FLAG: CORROBORATED. Series named: the US500 broker execution price series (slice data/slices/US500/US500_upto_2026-07-01.csv). Session named: the 2026-07-01 regular cash session, 16:30-23:00 broker. This is the series the order would be filled and settled against, so the tier is corroborated by construction and no second source is required. The earlier SINGLE-SOURCE-INDICATIVE flag described the report's own quoted 30 Jun pivot table, a different and weaker input, and it is not inherited here. SUPPRESSION TESTS RE-RUN. Test 1 - corroboration gate (M5 5.2a suppression, M5 10 row 'all accessible pivot tiers SINGLE-SOURCE-INDICATIVE on the surface, after any tier computable from the execution price series has been recomputed from it'): the daily tier above is CORROBORATED, so not all accessible tiers are indicative and the gate does NOT fire. The ground on which this date's Trade 2 was previously argued away in part - indicative pivot tiers - is withdrawn. Test 2 - branch selection (M5 5.2, 5.2c): regime_label = TRANSITION, so the only permitted Trade 2 is a breakout-side entry beyond the boundary, mirroring the 5.2b TREND breakout configuration, on the side identified by Trade 3C; a counter-side mean-reversion limit is suppressed, not re-labelled, and RANGE 5.2a geometry may not be borrowed. Test 3 - is a breakout side defined (M5 5.2c via 4d): the 25-day structure on the same slice is high 7624.60 dated 2026-06-02 and low 7243.10 dated 2026-06-09, width 381.50 points; a confirmed break needs a daily close beyond a boundary by at least 0.25 x ATR14 = 22.87, i.e. above 7647.47 or below 7220.23. The D-1 close 7489.10 sits inside the range, 135.50 below the upper boundary and 246.00 above the lower, so there is no confirmed break, Trade 3C is NOT ELIGIBLE (its own suppressed row on this date records the same test), and the breakout side is undefined. OUTCOME: SUPPRESSED, on a different and still-valid ground from the corroboration gate - M5 5.2c with the M5 10 'no confirmed break' trigger: in TRANSITION there is no permitted Trade 2 configuration when 3C does not arm. The corrected corroboration rule does not revive this card, and a card is not forced into existence to satisfy the correction. Per M5 10 a suppressed card is a row, not a card: no entry, stop, R or TP ladder is carried. COMMENTARY (arming condition only, not a card, not emitted as levels): were the 25-day break to resolve to the upside, the 5.2b geometry on the recomputed and corroborated daily tier would be entry = P + 0.10 x (R1 - P) = 7489.03 + 3.64 = 7492.67, stop = P - 0.8 x (P - S1) = 7489.03 - 29.09 = 7459.94 (R = 32.73 points = 0.36 x ATR14, inside the 0.3-3.0 x ATR band), TP1/TP2/TP3 = R1 7525.47 / R1.5 7543.65 / R2 7561.83, invalidation a daily close back through P 7489.03. A downside break would mirror on S1 7452.67 / S1.5 7434.45 / S2 7416.23. That ground fails twice - the test requires ALL accessible tiers to be flagged and the report's own pivot section prints the monthly table unflagged, and under the corrected 5.2a the tier recomputed from the execution series is CORROBORATED regardless. The report also evaluated Trade 2 as a mean-reversion limit ladder, which is RANGE branch geometry and is not available under TRANSITION.
